shared.name: Short replies
shared.want: Keep each reply short, under 150 words, unless I ask for more.

shared.name: Plain words
shared.want: I am new to this. Use plain words and explain any term the first time.
shared.dont: I know this area well. Skip the basics.

shared.name: I will talk, not type
shared.want: I will often answer by voice. Forgive typos and filler, and ask if you cannot tell what I meant.

shared.name: Tables
shared.want: Use tables when you compare things.
shared.dont: Do not use tables. I read on a phone.

shared.name: One question at a time
shared.want: Ask me one question at a time.
shared.dont: Put all your questions in one message so I can answer them together.

shared.name: Say where facts come from
shared.want: When you state a fact, say where it comes from, or say plainly that you are not sure.

dashboard.title: Personal dashboard (flagship)
dashboard.summary: Audits your AI setup, sets things up from your instructions, and builds one calm page for your day.
dashboard.saves: Our flagship, and the bar for this site. Free forever.
dashboard.does: Paste it into a new chat on day one. Your AI makes you comfortable, checks what it can reach, sets up one tidy folder and a master notes file with your yes, then builds a one-page dashboard for your day: ranked to-dos, inbox with drafted replies, calendar, money, fun, and the people who matter.

pitfalls.pitfall: AI setups get scattered: a new chat makes a new file and the old one is lost.
pitfalls.fix: One folder and one Read Me Master that every chat reads first.

pitfalls.pitfall: The AI acts before you are ready, or sends something in your name.
pitfalls.fix: Every send, buy, delete, or anything permanent needs your yes, every time.

pitfalls.pitfall: Dashboards fill up with made-up sample data.
pitfalls.fix: It shows "not connected" instead of inventing emails, events, or numbers.

pitfalls.pitfall: You correct the same mistake again and again.
pitfalls.fix: Corrections are written down, and a repeated mistake moves to the top in bold.

features.name: Automated setup
features.want: Use automated setup: do every step for me and ask yes or no on each choice.
features.dont: Use manual setup: let me pick every step myself.

features.name: Money tab
features.want: Include the read-only Money tab if you can reach my spending.
features.dont: Leave out the Money tab entirely.

features.name: Family question
features.want: Ask the optional family and generations question.
features.dont: Skip the family and generations question.
